findings.failure_path: The table reports the full Batch 2b size deltas, but the only oversized reference reduced in the 143,610-byte candidate is source-to-skill-extraction.md. The Bitable and acquisition reference edits and both over-budget entrypoint edits are absent. Applying this diff to the named baseline cannot produce the reported 0, 1, and 5 counts.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the omitted changes in the landing candidate, or identify the reviewed sibling partitions and bind a size-budget run to their assembled tree, including the zero-new-oversized-files result.

findings.failure_path: Only the final Python invocation receives the test environment. The fixture’s preceding git config, add, and commit commands inherit ambient GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, and GIT_INDEX_FILE. An absolute GIT_DIR pointing at a developer checkout can redirect the identity writes there, and an inherited index can receive the fixture’s staged file. Global commit signing or hooks can also interrupt setup.
findings.smallest_fix: Create and commit the fixture in a subshell with isolated Git routing, index, home, and config. Check setup success before invoking the validator with the deliberately poisoned environment.

findings.failure_path: The opener and closer accept arbitrary leading whitespace. At document level, a lone delimiter indented four spaces after a blank line is indented code under CommonMark. The parser opens a fence there and skips the following top-level rule through EOF. Deleting that rule can therefore yield zero rows.
findings.smallest_fix: Apply the zero-to-three-column fence indentation limit relative to the active Markdown container on both open and close. Add a regression that deletes a real top-level rule after an indented literal delimiter and requires one row.

findings.failure_path: Scrubbing GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS removes an existing caller protection. In a repository with replacement refs, read_rev can now compare substituted content even when the caller explicitly requested original objects. That can change the obligation verdict for the same named revisions.
findings.smallest_fix: Pass --no-replace-objects to the Git read and add a fixture with a replacement ref that changes the expected row count.

findings.failure_path: GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS survives the environment filter. Git reads this separate channel for command-scoped config, so inherited parameters can still affect the revision read. A malformed inherited value can make an otherwise valid comparison exit with an input error. The GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE test misses this path.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS from the child environment and extend the revision-read fixture to cover it.

findings.failure_path: Four of the five reported green suites concern code and tests missing from the frozen candidate. In particular, a reviewer cannot trace corrupt JUnit input through baseline preservation or a symlink output through fetch(). The ten-file before/after digest only records the claimed restoration of a worktree and does not connect those results to the landing tree.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply the corresponding implementation and test partitions and bind their RED/GREEN and mutation results to the assembled candidate. Keep those results pending for this release until that binding exists.

findings.failure_path: The 654-row verdict depends on two linked tables containing 229 and 223 rows that the candidate does not supply. Even the supplied 202-row table includes nine test-artifact-management rows whose destination edits are absent. The claim that every destination has exactly one carrier cannot be checked from these artifacts.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply both missing tables and their destination revisions, then verify the complete row set against the same assembled tree used for release.

findings.failure_path: The former rule kept one or two methods in the index and prescribed a split when a third broad method was needed. The replacement tells authors to split broad methods without that threshold. Preservation row SEW_SRC#002 nevertheless marks the qualifier as preserved. A future author following the new rule can split the first method.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep the original numeric trigger in the index, or explicitly record the policy change and correct the preservation verdict.

findings.failure_path: Updating the index links repairs navigation from this page, but existing links to source-to-skill-extraction.md#database-and-dal-extraction-method, #redis-extraction-method, and the moved design sections lose their targets. The source register’s claim that all fragment headings were preserved is contradicted by their deletion.
findings.smallest_fix: Retain anchor-only aliases for the old fragments beside links to the new sections and verify the old URLs still resolve.

findings.failure_path: The release ledger ends with boundary acceptance pending. It gives no final-candidate result for select-affected-tests.py --run, make test-repo-gates, full pre-push, the required make test and heavy regression lanes, or the two directory-contract leak tests. Its private R0 result refers to HEAD plus a mutable worktree. A maintainer cannot establish which exact tree cleared the merge gates.
findings.smallest_fix: On the assembled release tree, record its immutable identity and the actual commands, exit statuses, private R0 terminal tokens, and review/challenge dispositions. Mark any outstanding gate pending.

concern_results.conclusion: On the stated baseline, the frozen candidate retires one of the three oversized references. It contains neither of the two entrypoint reductions needed for the word and severe-debt targets.
The new regression fixture runs Git configuration, staging, and commit commands before isolating them from the caller’s Git environment. Those writes can reach the caller’s repository.
The fence parser handles the tested delimiter lengths and characters, but a four-space-indented delimiter can still make it silently skip a subsequent deleted obligation.

The T2 fixtures are present. The implementations and regression changes for T1a, T1b, T3, and T4 are outside the frozen diff, so their reported results and nine associated mutations cannot establish acceptance for this candidate.
The method-index rewrite changes the condition for splitting references and removes the old section anchors. Both changes affect consumers of the existing guidance.
The Markdown moves are reversible in Git. Release readiness remains open because the ledger records partition acceptance as pending and lacks final gate results for the assembled candidate.

The ledger gives recognizable T2 failure messages. The claimed unreadable-directory and corrupt-XML diagnostics belong to omitted code, and the recorded HEAD plus worktree audit does not identify the exact state audited.
The supplied preservation table accounts for 202 of 654 rows. One visible row already contradicts qualifier parity, and the two tables supporting the other 452 rows are absent from the candidate.

The shared gate can omit a real obligation through fence misclassification or read replacement objects despite a caller’s explicit protection. The claimed symlink and report-baseline protections cannot be inspected in this packet.

The script has synthetic fixtures as required by the nearer contract. The ledger lacks candidate-bound results for the root contract’s full and heavy test lanes and the two focused leak checks named by the scripts contract.
